plugins.name: blaine-mono
plugins.description: An 8-bit pink monorail crossing the waste lands above the prompt. Where it sits between Lud and Topeka shows how full the context is. /blaine shows or hides it.

plugins.name: gunslinger
plugins.description: Roland follows the man in black across an 8-bit Mohaine Desert above the prompt. Roland's place is the context fill, the man in black waits at the window's edge, and a skull marks compaction. He draws on tool errors and every so often while Claude works. /gunslinger shows or hides him.

plugins.name: touchstone
plugins.description: Saves the facts of a session (git state, the whole uncommitted patch, your last words verbatim) just before it is compacted, tells the model where they are, and warns when the preserve note it will be handed is stale. /touchstone saves them on demand.

plugins.name: oy
plugins.description: Oy, the billy-bumbler who repeats your words back, cleaned up. /oy your rough thought puts a clear, ordered prompt in the box with a short line of things for you to confirm. It never sends anything.
